courses.summary: Quest 在 Scotford 升級廠的製氫流程捕集二氧化碳；本課分開來源捕集率、能源代價與封存量測帳。本課依序分析製氫來源捕集邊界、氫氣產品與來源排放、捕集能源代價、捕集到封存質量帳、捕集停機與全廠邊界，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Quest captures CO2 from hydrogen production at Scotford’s upgrader; teaching separates source capture, energy penalties and stored-mass measurement. The course analyses capture boundary around hydrogen production, hydrogen output and source emissions, capture-energy penalty, capture-to-storage mass account, capture downtime and plant-wide boundaries, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
